Game Overview

Circle Dash puts players into a hyper-casual experience centered on guide your circle through a vibrant world, collecting food while dodging menacing viruses. Quick taps change your path, demanding sharp reflexes and strategic movement. Immerse yourself in this calming yet challenging experience, perfect for touchscreen or desktop play. Can you master the art of quick direction shifts?
